connector.name: AgentAuth
connector.registryDescription: Identity and auth for AI agents: credentials, tokens, delegations, and permission checks.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package agentauth-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the raditotev account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AGENTAUTH_URL
env.description: Base URL of the AgentAuth service (e.g. https://agentauth.radi.pro or http://localhost:8000 for self-hosted)

env.name: AGENTAUTH_API_KEY
env.description: Default API key for the authenticate tool. Optional — can also be passed per call.
